ipos.story: Founded in 2021 in San Francisco by former OpenAI researchers and led by CEO Dario Amodei, Anthropic is set up as a public benefit corporation. It reported revenue of about $33B in the first nine months of 2026, up from $2.5B a year earlier. It priced its IPO at $83 a share on Nov 18, 2026 — above the $70–$78 range — and began trading on Nasdaq on Nov 19. Underwriters then fully exercised their option for 147M extra shares, taking the offering to 1,127M shares and about $93.5B gross proceeds; with the $26B private placement to seven suppliers, the combined raise was about $119.5B. At $81.3B before the greenshoe, it was already the largest IPO ever by proceeds.
watchNotes: Priced at $83 on Nov 18, above the $70–$78 range, and upsized from 825M to 980M shares — the largest IPO ever by proceeds

Market data (Reuters, Nov 22): five brokerages outside the underwriting syndicate initiated coverage after the debut, with price targets averaging $134 (range $105–$155); the deal's banks cannot publish research until the quiet period ends around Nov 30
Market data (Reuters): shares opened at $111.50 and closed the first day at $97.17, up 17% on the $83 IPO price
Reported about 6× oversubscribed (Bloomberg), with an unusually large ~20% of the deal aimed at retail investors
Seven of its suppliers — Google, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC — agreed to buy $26B of stock alongside the IPO
Amazon will hold over 5% of the company after the offering
Market data (Motley Fool, Nov 23): shares closed at $87.64 on Mon Nov 23, down 1.4% on the day — still above the $83 IPO price — even as the Nasdaq posted its best day since April 2025
ipos.whatItDoes: Anthropic builds Claude, a family of AI models used by businesses, developers and everyday users for writing, coding and analysis. It sells access to its models and subscriptions, and counts Google and Amazon among its biggest backers.

ipos.story: Founded in 2016 in Boston and formerly called NodThera (renamed Sep 9, 2026), Rezera filed its S-1 on Oct 21, 2026 and set terms on Nov 5: 16.7M shares at $11–$13 to raise about $200M, with drugmaker GSK indicating it would buy up to $25M of the offering. It was expected to price during the week of Nov 9, but postponed the deal on Nov 12 before pricing. Its lead drug, ruvonoflast, is being prepared for a Phase 3 trial in peripheral artery disease starting in the first half of 2027. The company is pre-revenue and lost $66.3M in the year to June 30, 2026.

ipos.whatItDoes: Rezera is a clinical-stage biotech company developing oral pills that block NLRP3, a protein that drives inflammation — the aim is to treat heart and artery disease in patients for whom statins aren't enough.
